sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday for a 15:00 kickoff, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach's form has been strong overall—they've won seven of their ten games and sit top of the table on 22 points—but Alsager present a difficult opponent despite their lowly league position, having won just once all season and currently on a five-game winless run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture that could extend Stafford's title challenge, with both teams needing a response after recent defeats. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) face Eccleshall (5th) in a clash between two of the league's stronger performers, with both teams capable of maintaining their positive trajectories. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) visit Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday, though Wednesfield's inconsistent form makes them a potential banana skin. Bilston Town (6th), currently in strong form, travel to Foley Meir in what could be a key moment in the mid-table battle. Barnton host Shawbury United—Shawbury sit in the bottom half and are in freefall with six consecutive losses, making them vulnerable visitors. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town, with both sides fighting for consistency in the lower reaches of the table. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home in a fixture between struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a relegation-zone six-pointer. Finally, Widnes Town's visit to Brereton Social on Saturday will see the league's bottom club (Widnes, on just 2 points from seven games) tackle a team themselves in poor form after their recent defeat.
